length_limits.notes: Nine pages of main text at submission, rising to ten for the discussion phase and camera-ready. References are unlimited and do not count. Appendices follow the bibliography and may be any length, though reviewers need not read them.

reference_style.style: Not stated on the page; the style file sets it. Self-citations are written in the third person.

submission_steps: submit the paper and any supplementary material as a single file
include the mandatory AI-use statement, which does not count toward the page limit
an ethics statement of up to one page and a reproducibility statement are optional and uncounted
the cycle caps an author at 20 papers and ties reviewing quotas to submissions

template.notes: A style-file zip downloads without a login; no Word template is mentioned. Linked, never stored.

license_of_summary_source.statement: No copyright or terms-of-use statement was found on the page.
